description: Reserve calendar time for a to-do by exact todo_id: creates one private linked event, keeps the to-do and never changes its due date. Call only when the user told you to schedule it and gave the timing. Timed: date, start_time, timezone, and end_time or duration_minutes. All day: date and all_day true. Missing details fail with missing[]: ask, do not guess. If you are only suggesting slots, say them and do not call this. add_session true is required for a second session. ($0.05; API key required)

add_session.description: True only when the user asked for another session.

all_day.description: True only when the user chose a whole day. Takes no times.

date.description: The day of the session. Ask the user; never assume today.

end_time.description: HH:MM in the given time zone.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

session_key.description: Optional stable identity of this session. Retrying it returns the same session.

start_time.description: HH:MM in the given time zone.

todo_id.description: Exact id from get_todos or create_todo. Titles are not accepted.
